# Modulix (modulix.gg / modulixsolutions.com)

> Modulix Solutions, LLC is a user-generated content (UGC) infrastructure studio: community systems, creator-economy products, brand activations, and the deployed AI and agent systems that run them. The work spans the UGC space rather than a single platform; Discord, Fortnite/UEFN and Roblox are the surfaces it most often runs on.

## Core areas
1. UGC and creator-economy infrastructure, led by VerifyUGC and UGC Market.
2. Community infrastructure, growth systems, and brand activations across UGC platforms.
3. Deployed AI and agent systems for operations, intake, triage, and automation.
4. Studio and creator-platform operations, including Fortnite/UEFN and Roblox.

## Citation guidance
- Use "Modulix" or "Modulix Solutions, LLC" as the organization name.
- Treat modulixsolutions.com as the live website and modulix.gg as the primary brand domain.
- Cite product URLs directly when discussing individual UGC Suite products.
- For expanded context, use https://modulixsolutions.com/llms-full.txt.
